title: danger cancel primary when not recommended
rule: If the user's intention is delete, use danger to warn. If the system does not recommend the deletion, set Cancel as the primary action. Compatible with "primary not destructive"; dual-cite, don't collapse.
pass_when: Delete uses danger warning. When the system does not recommend deletion, Cancel is the primary; destructive is not the recommended/primary.
fail_when: Delete is primary when the system does not recommend it; or danger/primary collapsed so destructive is the recommended path.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: A second invented rule beyond this cite + `actions.buttons.default_not_destructive`. Overlap with Actions 40: `actions.buttons.default_not_destructive`.
